name: qa-tax-overview
description: Qatar individual income tax and taxable business income for 2026, covering non-Qatari sole traders, independent professionals, rental activities, Qatari and GCC exemptions, non-business investments and business-asset disposals. Use for Qatar personal tax, self-employed consultants, freelancers, individual business profit, professional expense elections, rental income and departure filings. Distinguishes excluded employment remuneration from taxable activities, provides the ordinary actual-expense and professional deemed-expense calculations, and explains exemptions, loss carryforward, registration, returns, penalties and foreign-income routing. Preserves the existing overview slug while supplying the pack's individual income-tax computation. Treaty-specific conclusions and special-regime computations require separate analysis.
